channel.title: AI Tool Stack — Clinical LLM Benchmarks & AI Tools for Surgeons
channel.description: Hands-on, source-backed AI tool comparisons and clinical LLM benchmarks by Dr. Tan Haosheng (谭好升), Associate Chief Physician, Taizhou People's Hospital.

item.title: About - Dr. Tan Haosheng · AI Tool Stack
item.description: About Dr. Tan Haosheng (谭好升): Associate Chief Physician, MD/PhD from Tsinghua–Peking Union / National Cancer Center, now at Taizhou People's Hospital. Author of AI Tool Stack.

item.title: Web vs Agent on One Case: 4 Models, 12 Runs | AI Tool Stack
item.description: Part 3: 4 models × 3 runs on one breast-cancer case — web vs WorkBuddy agent. Agent raises the floor, not the ceiling (16-item/100 rubric).

item.title: Configuring Agnes in WorkBuddy: Free Agent | AI Tool Stack
item.description: A step-by-step guide to configuring the free Agnes-2.0-flash model in WorkBuddy. Highlights its practical usability, with a note on its slightly slower response time.

item.title: ChatGLM 5.2 vs DeepSeek: Breast Cancer Case | AI Tool Stack
item.description: A surgeon's hands-on test of ChatGLM 5.2 vs DeepSeek on a real anonymized post-op breast-cancer case, scored with the 16-item/100 rubric against 2026 CBCS. ChatGLM 5/100; DeepSeek 28/100.

item.title: 4 Free AI Models on One Breast Cancer Case | AI Tool Stack
item.description: 4 free AI models on one anonymized post-op breast-cancer case, scored with the 16-item/100 rubric. Only DeepSeek V4 Pro caught the staging trap (50/100); Doubao 41; DeepSeek web 28; ChatGLM 5.

item.title: How I Built This Site With an AI Agent | AI Tool Stack
item.description: A surgeon's honest build log: 4 days from idea to launch with an AI agent — the content-farm trap, the great deletion (361 → 3 articles), the pivot to real hands-on testing, and every lesson learned.

item.title: AI Tool Stack — Clinical LLM Benchmark & AI Tools for Surgeons
item.description: The AI-era tool-selection guide for surgeons — pick the right AI model and tool with clear, source-backed comparisons.

item.title: Kimi K2.6 Web vs Agent (Review 4/5) | AI Tool Stack
item.description: Kimi K2.6 tested as plain web chat vs inside the WorkBuddy agent on one anonymized post-op breast-cancer case. Agent median 72.2/100 vs web 68.9/100 (16-item rubric).

item.title: Model Reviews: Free AI Hands-on Tests (V1→V5) | AI Tool Stack
item.description: Free AI models tested hands-on on one anonymized post-op breast-cancer case, scored with a 16-item/100 rubric against 2026 CBCS guidelines. The full V1→V5 series.

item.title: Site Map — AI Tool Stack
item.description: Full index of all pages on AI Tool Stack — free AI model hands-on tests and clinical LLM benchmarks by Dr. Tan Haosheng.

item.title: 全系列统一评分标准 · V1–V5 重算（单一病例）
item.description: Unified V1–V5 scoring on one patient with one 16-item/100 rubric and two prompt modes. Retired the old 10-item table and the '+39' delta.

item.title: 指南注入实测 · V5（四模型同尺对比）
item.description: V5 hands-on: guideline injection tested on four free models against one anonymized post-op breast-cancer case with the unified 16-item/100 rubric. Baseline 60–68, +6 to +10 after guidance.

item.title: WorkBuddy Free Agent (Hunyuan hy3): Hands-on | AI Tool Stack
item.description: A screenshot-driven walkthrough by Tan Haosheng on WorkBuddy (Tencent): sign-up, WeChat login, the credits system, where Hunyuan hy3 fits, and the model-picker UI.

item.title: WorkBuddy 免费运行 Agent（混元 hy3）实测：注册、积分机制与首批流程 - AI Tool Stack
item.description: 作者 Tan Haosheng 在 WorkBuddy（workbuddy.cn）实操的全记录。详细拆解注册、微信登录、积分机制（任务/签到）、混元 hy3 模型定位与首页/下载页界面。后续段落（建 Agent / 跑任务 / 积分消耗 / 产出物）随流程补全。

item.title: Free-Model Clinical LLM Leaderboard | AI Tool Stack
item.description: A living leaderboard of free AI models on one breast-cancer case, scored against 2026 CBCS / CSCO 2024 / NCCN 2025. Key finding: the agent wrapper raises a model's floor more than its ceiling.

item.title: Case 1 — Reading the data, checking a draft · AI Tool Stack
item.description: A surgeon's real hands-on test of an AI agent on a research workload: identify a sample preparation, then hold a draft to the data. Behaviour and timing only — no scientific result is disclosed.

item.title: Case 2 — The mismatch trap · AI Tool Stack
item.description: A surgeon's real hands-on test of an AI agent: attach a draft from an unrelated line of work to the same dataset and see whether the agent notices the mismatch. Behaviour and timing only.

item.title: Case 3 — From raw data to a research plan · AI Tool Stack
item.description: A surgeon's real hands-on test of an AI agent as a forward planner: given raw data, what could realistically be written and where could it go? Behaviour and timing only — no result disclosed.

item.title: AI Agents for Medical Research | AI Tool Stack
item.description: First-hand case studies of an AI agent (WorkBuddy Hy3) on a surgeon-researcher's own workload — what it handled, where it pushed back, where it failed. Behaviour only; no results disclosed.

item.title: Methodology: Testing AI Agents | AI Tool Stack
item.description: The protocol for testing AI agents on real medical research tasks: prompt construction, data attachment, evaluation rubric, and the four failure modes to watch. Reproducible and honest.
